title: ntfy
descript: ntfy is a self-hosted push-notification service: publish a message to a topic with a single PUT/POST from any script, monitoring tool or the web UI, then read it in the web UI, the API, WebSocket/SSE or the ntfy phone app. Messages, users and configuration stay in the application data folder, and the server contacts no third-party service unless you enable one of the opt-in integrations. File attachments are disabled until you set base-url and attachment-cache-dir in server.yml.
release_note: 2.38.2-1: rectified per review comments. D18/F2/F7 - removed the redundant attachment-cache-dir setting that made the container exit at startup, so the service now runs and the web UI opens. C3 - complete privacy policy linked from Help. C8 - third-party API table (Docker Hub, optional upstream iOS relay, FCM, web push, SMTP, Twilio). C9 - descriptions match the delivered features, attachments documented as opt-in. L01/L03 - 23-language file regenerated without ASCII semicolons and with LF endings. S11/V1 - non-root uid 1000, capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, umask 077 and databases 0600. T1 - upstream 2.38.2 security release.
important: Requires DockerEngine. Open http://<NAS-IP>:8034/ - the web UI and the API share the port. Runs as uid 1000, capabilities dropped. No authentication by default: anyone who can reach it can publish and subscribe to any topic, so keep it on the LAN or add a user with docker exec -it ntfydocker ntfy user add --role=admin <name> and set NTFY_AUTH_DEFAULT_ACCESS=deny-all. Cache, users and config live in DockerAppData/ntfydocker. Plain HTTP - use a TLS reverse proxy off-LAN. Privacy policy: see the Help link.

zh-cn.descript: ntfy 是一个自建的推送通知服务：任何脚本、监控工具或网页只要发一个 PUT/POST 到某个 topic，就能在网页、API、WebSocket/SSE 或 ntfy 手机 App 里收到消息。消息、用户与配置都保存在应用数据目录，除非你主动启用可选出站集成，服务端不连接任何第三方服务。附件功能默认关闭，需在 server.yml 里同时设置 base-url 与 attachment-cache-dir 才能启用。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine。打开 http://<NAS-IP>:8034/，网页与 API 共用该端口。容器以 uid 1000 运行并丢弃全部 capability。默认没有鉴权：任何能访问该端口的人都能向任意 topic 发布或订阅，请只在内网使用，或先用 docker exec -it ntfydocker ntfy user add --role=admin <用户名> 建用户，并把 NTFY_AUTH_DEFAULT_ACCESS 设为 deny-all。缓存、用户与配置都在 DockerAppData/ntfydocker。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露公网前请加带 TLS 的反向代理。隐私政策见帮助链接。

zh-hk.descript: ntfy 是一個自建的推送通知服務：任何腳本、監控工具或網頁只要發一個 PUT/POST 到某個 topic，就能在網頁、API、WebSocket/SSE 或 ntfy 手機 App 裡收到訊息。訊息、使用者與設定都保存在應用資料目錄，除非你主動啟用可選出站整合，伺服器不連接任何第三方服務。附件功能預設關閉，需在 server.yml 裡同時設定 base-url 與 attachment-cache-dir 才能啟用。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine。開啟 http://<NAS-IP>:8034/，網頁與 API 共用該埠。容器以 uid 1000 執行並丟棄全部 capability。預設沒有驗證：任何能存取該埠的人都能向任意 topic 發佈或訂閱，請只在內網使用，或先用 docker exec -it ntfydocker ntfy user add --role=admin <使用者名稱> 建立使用者，並把 NTFY_AUTH_DEFAULT_ACCESS 設為 deny-all。快取、使用者與設定都在 DockerAppData/ntfydocker。介面為純 HTTP，暴露公網前請加帶 TLS 的反向代理。隱私政策見說明連結。

data_notes: `/var/cache/ntfy` (mounted from `DockerAppData/ntfydocker/cache`) keeps the message cache and, when attachments are enabled, the uploaded files. `/etc/ntfy` (mounted from `.../config`) is where you put `server.yml` to add users, access control, a base URL or attachments. `/var/lib/ntfy` (mounted from `.../lib`) keeps `user.db` and `webpush.db`.
design_notes: **Non-root by port choice.** The image defaults to port 80, which an unprivileged container cannot bind. The package runs as uid 1000, starts `ntfy serve` on `NTFY_LISTEN_HTTP=:8080`, drops all capabilities and sets `no-new-privileges`.

**Private state files.** A small wrapper sets `umask 077` before starting the server, so `cache.db`, `user.db` and `webpush.db` are created 0600 and the three data folders are tightened to 0700. The databases hold messages, password hashes and access tokens.
**No external database.** The message cache is a file-based SQLite store inside the cache volume.
**One HTTP port for UI and API.** Publishing is a plain PUT/POST, so scripts and the phone app need nothing but the URL.

**Attachments are opt-in.** Upstream refuses to start when `attachment-cache-dir` is set without `base-url`, and the NAS address is not known inside the container. The package therefore leaves both unset. Set both in `config/server.yml` to enable attachments.
limitations: - No authentication out of the box: anyone reaching the port can publish to any topic. Add an auth file or keep it on the LAN.
- The web UI is plain HTTP. Use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- File attachments are disabled by default. Enable them by setting `base-url` and `attachment-cache-dir` together in `config/server.yml`.
- iOS instant notifications need a user-configured upstream server; without it, delivery to iOS may take hours. Android delivery does not involve this server.
